strings.name: Aamir Khan
strings.role: Actor, director and producer · Hindi cinema
strings.summary: Aamir Khan was born into a Mumbai film family and appeared in films as a child before entering mainstream cinema through romantic leading roles. He combined acting and production in works including Lagaan, 3 Idiots and Dangal, which address collective action, educational pressure and gender expectations. His directorial debut Taare Zameen Par considers a child’s dyslexia, while the television program Satyamev Jayate brought social issues into public discussion.
strings.coverageNote: Sources checked through 13 November 2026; selected chronology extends to a production-career anniversary event in June 2026. Film releases, award nominations and later distribution plans are distinguished.
strings.influence.rationale: Used films including 3 Idiots and Dangal to explore education and social issues, advancing the international reach of Indian cinema.

strings.highlights.highlight-01.title: Social questions in popular storytelling
strings.highlights.highlight-01.text: Films such as 3 Idiots and Dangal bring education, family and gender expectations into popular cinema.
strings.highlights.highlight-02.title: Expanding from acting to filmmaking
strings.highlights.highlight-02.text: Produced and starred in Lagaan, then directed Taare Zameen Par, developing different subjects and approaches to production.
strings.timeline.event-01.title: Marks twenty-five years of production
strings.timeline.event-01.text: Joined collaborators at a celebration of Lagaan’s twenty-fifth anniversary, reflecting on the company’s film and television work.
strings.timeline.event-02.title: Sitaare Zameen Par opens in cinemas
strings.timeline.event-02.text: Played a coach in RS Prasanna’s film, working with first-time actors with disabilities in a sports story about acceptance.
strings.timeline.event-03.title: Stars in Laal Singh Chaddha
strings.timeline.event-03.text: Produced and starred in an Indian adaptation of Forrest Gump, connecting personal experience with decades of social change.
strings.timeline.event-04.title: Stars in and co-produces Dangal
strings.timeline.event-04.text: Played wrestling coach Mahavir Singh Phogat in a story about a father training his daughters and confronting gender expectations.
strings.timeline.event-05.title: Launches Satyamev Jayate
strings.timeline.event-05.text: Worked as host and producer of a social-issues program, using interviews and individual stories to broaden public discussion.
strings.timeline.event-06.title: Stars in 3 Idiots
strings.timeline.event-06.text: Worked with director Rajkumar Hirani on a story of engineering students’ friendship and growth that questions rigid educational expectations.
strings.timeline.event-07.title: Makes his feature directing debut with Taare Zameen Par
strings.timeline.event-07.text: Directed and acted in a film centered on a child with dyslexia, emphasizing learning differences and an educator’s understanding.
strings.timeline.event-08.title: Produces and stars in Lagaan
strings.timeline.event-08.text: Told a collective story of villagers challenging colonial authorities to cricket; the film later received an Oscar nomination for foreign-language film.
strings.timeline.event-09.title: Breaks through with Qayamat Se Qayamat Tak
strings.timeline.event-09.text: Played the romantic lead opposite Juhi Chawla, establishing the direction of his professional adult acting career.
strings.timeline.event-10.title: Appears as a child in Yaadon Ki Baaraat
strings.timeline.event-10.text: Made a small appearance in his uncle Nasir Hussain’s film, gaining early experience of filmmaking.
strings.timeline.event-11.title: Born into a Bombay film family
strings.timeline.event-11.text: Born in Bombay to film producer Tahir Hussain, growing up with close connections to the film industry.
